Ukraine reported that Starlink speed curbs persist despite promises to restore service. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Iran has threatened to strike oil facilities, AI sites and undersea cables across the Gulf if hostilities resume, and it reports seven ships hit in the Hormuz Strait. Saudi Arabia’s King Fahd airport was hit by missiles, killing one person and wounding eight, prompting the United States to order its personnel to leave Saudi Arabia and advise diplomats to depart. Russian Foreign Minister Lavrov visited Tehran and publicly backed Iran, hinting at possible Russian involvement as the United States and Israel draft plans for renewed strikes after the US midterm elections. Saudi Arabia is expanding a missile plant that may produce more powerful missiles. 123 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Saudi-Arabias Kong Fahd-flyplass ble truffet av missiler, ett menneske ble drept og åtte såret, noe som førte til at USA beordret sitt personell til å forlate Saudi-Arabia og rådet diplomater til å dra. Saudi-Arabia utvider et missilverk som kan produsere kraftigere missiler. 123 kamprelaterte dødsfall skjedde i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Israeli forces fired across the border into southern Syria, killing a Syrian man with disabilities in the Daraa buffer zone and deploying rooftop snipers who opened fire in the south. Two Syrian security officers were killed in a raid on an ISIL cell near Damascus. Hundreds of Syrians protested repeated Israeli incursions while Syrian Christians faced heightened risk of killing or abduction. Jordanian and Syrian foreign ministers held expanded talks in Aqaba after attacks on churches in Jordan, and a US envoy noted that Syria's interim leader seeks Israel normalization. The war caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

To syriske sikkerhetsoffiserer ble drept i et raid på en IS-celle nær Damaskus. Hundrevis av syrere protesterte mot gjentatte israelske inntrengninger, mens syriske kristne stod overfor økt risiko for drap eller bortføring. approved.en: Sudanese armed forces have carried out drone strikes on markets in the disputed Abyei border region, killing more than 150 people in each attack. The strikes hit civilian gatherings, including mourners and a fuel market, causing hundreds of casualties. Communal clashes continue, with killings reported between Warrap and Lakes communities and arrests related to youth violence in Juba. Fresh attacks in Ruweng left nine dead and six wounded, and bodies arrived from the Khor Kaltan killings in Northern Bahr el Ghazal. The UCDP recorded two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Den sudanske hæren har gjennomført droneangrep på markeder i den omstridte grenseområdet Abyei, og drept mer enn 150 personer i hvert angrep. Angrepene rammet sivile samlinger, inkludert sørgende og et drivstoffmarked, og forårsaket hundrevis av skadde. Kommunale sammenstøt fortsetter, med drap rapportert mellom Warrap- og Lakes-samfunnene og arrestasjoner knyttet til ungdomsvold i Juba. Nye angrep i Ruweng etterlot ni døde og seks sårede, og lik ankom fra drapene i Khor Kaltan i Nord-Bahr el Ghazal. UCDP registrerte to dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

The United States, through Secretary of State Marco Rubio, is urging Ethiopia and Eritrea to de-escalate, and Mekelle mayor Shishay Amare announced elections within six months to settle Western Tigray through constitutional processes. A drone strike in the disputed Abyei region killed at least 73 people, and the TPLF claims to have killed 1,511 Ethiopian soldiers in recent fighting. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

USA, gjennom utenriksminister Marco Rubio, oppfordrer Etiopia og Eritrea til å dempe konflikten, og Mekelle borgermester Shishay Amare kunngjorde valg innen seks måneder for å løse Vest-Tigray gjennom konstitusjonelle prosesser. Et droneangrep i det omstridte Abyei-området drepte minst 73 personer, og TPLF hevder å ha drept 1 511 etiopiske soldater i nylige kamper. approved.en: Fitgharan forces now control the Mogadishu-Baidoa corridor while Laftagareen forces have seized Buurhakaba and another town in the Bay region, expanding fighting in southern Somalia. Al Shabaab detonated an IED in Mandera, injuring six civilians, and the ICRC treated 148 wounded after heavy combat in Baidoa. Ethiopia has withdrawn more than 3,000 troops and will not intervene in the South West State conflict, while a UAE drone strike in Puntland killed four family members, including a pregnant teenager. The US and UAE carried out airstrikes against al-Shabaab in northern Somalia, and 2,284 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
